svg.title: Commanding a node from its panel
svg.desc: With the two ends matched on A, Disable on a panel sends STOP_NODE for that panel's node; the vehicle stops it and answers Success, and the panel says Stopped. Enable sends START_NODE; a vehicle that does not start the node answers Failure, which Last Response shows, and the panel keeps Stopped. Query, from the Command menu, sends one QUERY_NODE per panel, and the answers set each panel's status and the counts its Configuration shows.

text.style: font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold

svg.text: Arrowhead: read or acted on. Cross: dropped and counted, or not acted on. The words at each end say which.
